name: Assemblio
author: Philipp Lühmann
description: A factory-building puzzle: lay conveyor belts to carry items into the central hub and reach the quota it asks for. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

descriptions.en: A factory-building puzzle: lay conveyor belts to carry items into the central hub and reach the quota it asks for. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle di costruzione industriale: posa nastri trasportatori per portare i pezzi al centro di raccolta e raggiungere la quota richiesta.
